commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src conda run -n autodrift python -m autodrift.input_observability_audit --env-config configs/m91c_raw_wheel_minimum_profile.json --episodes 40 --seed 9350 --policy heuristic --horizon-steps 15 --sample-stride 3 --max-samples 1000 --ridge 0.1 --history-windows 10,25,50 --history-mode summary --run-dir runs/m91f_compact_history_observability_seed9350
commands.name: compact_history_observability_probe

decision_rule: Compare compact command-response history summaries against naive raw-frame history before moving to sensor ablations or PPO.
failure_criteria: history summary mode leaks future observations
history summary mode cannot preserve P0/P1 profile comparability
compact history performs no better than current-frame baseline on all targets
results are used as promoted policy evidence
hypothesis: Compact history summaries should capture command-response adaptation signals better than high-dimensional raw frame concatenation.
success_criteria: summary-mode probes run without changing PPO or reward settings
compact history improves at least one target over raw history at the same window
P1 raw wheel summary is compared against P0 no-wheel summary at identical windows
decision states whether to proceed to minimum-set sensor ablations
